description: American Shared Hospital Services provides technology solutions for stereotactic radiosurgery and advanced radiation therapy equipment and services. It operates in two segments: Leasing and Direct Patient Service. The company leases nine Gamma Knife systems and one proton beam radiation therapy (PBRT) system; and provides planning, installation, reimbursement, and marketing support services. It also owns and operates two single-unit Gamma Knife facilities that provides radiosurgery services directly to the patient.
